data.title: Diamondz by Danube
data.about:
Diamondz by Danube is a glittering new addition to the Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT) community. This residential masterpiece caters to the discerning tastes of homeowners and investors alike. 

The highlights of the skyscraper are the aesthetically designed lift lobby and the amenities spanning the podium, level 2, and level 3. The facilities include sky golf, an infinity pool, yoga and zumba decks, and an open-air cinema. Danube Diamondz JLT


A project by Danube Properties, the tower has studio to 4-bedroom apartments. Large floor-to-ceiling windows in the living area of Danube Diamondz Residences allow residents to enjoy uninterrupted vistas of the city. Conveniently located just minutes from the DMCC metro station, Diamondz ensures seamless connectivity to various parts of Dubai, making it an ideal choice for urban living.

characteristics_module.title: Elevate your lifestyle with luxury amenities and a sought-after location
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Enjoy stunning views of the city skyline from your living area.
  • Own a luxury apartment by making monthly payments of just 1 per cent of the total for 75 months.
  • 40+ exceptional amenities spread across three floors, from the infinity pool to the aquatic gym.
  • The tower has a meticulously designed exterior and interior, encompassing units with luxury finishing.
  • Choose from a range of apartments, including studio, 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments with or without a private pool.
  • A strategic location provides residents with proximity to landmarks like Marina Walk, Ain Dubai, and Marina Mall.

location_tile.title: Located in the vibrant hub at the heart of technological advancements and global connectivity
location_tile.heading: LOCATION
location_tile.description:
Diamonds Danube is in JLT, a luxury district with exceptional residential and commercial properties. With its cosmopolitan ambience and stunning architectural marvels, this bustling neighbourhood offers an array of amenities to cater to every lifestyle. With its strategic location providing easy access to major landmarks such as Marina Walk, Ain Dubai, and Marina Mall, JLT emerges as a coveted destination for those seeking luxury, convenience, and unparalleled experiences in the heart of Dubai's thriving metropolis.

  • 02 minutes to DMCC Metro Station 
  • 03 minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
  • 03 minutes to Jumeirah Island
  • 10 minutes to Palm Jumeirah
  • 20 minutes to Dubai Frame
